For morning, Mommy don wake before sun, she dey cook breakfast and pack lunch for everybody.
Jojo whisper give Pip, I think say Mommy fit fly! She dey here, then she dey there, for one blink.
She fix the sink, she plait hair. She find Pip shoe under the chair.
She rock Baby Bee as she dey stir pot. Anything dey, Pip ask, wey Mommy no fit do?
Pip make cape from one red towel. My Mommy na superhero! Pip talk with pride.
But one rainy evening, plate full sink, Mommy sit down slow and draw long breath.
She forget say Pip library book suppose return today, and one tear roll down quietly.
Pip pull Jojo sleeve. Mommy don spoil? Her power don disappear like smoke?
Jojo no know, so him scratch him head. Make we go ask Mommy, na wetin him talk.
Mommy clean her eye and draw dem near. I get one secret, and I want make una hear.
Even though una no notice, e hard to see, Mommy na human being. I no come from juju. I no be superhero; this one no be new. God make me for Him image, as He make the sky blue.
Hunger dey catch me, sleep dey catch me, I need hug too. Sometimes I dey forget tins, same as una. I no fit do everything, and I no suppose try. Even sun dey go rest from the sky.
When I weak, I go meet God and pray, and He go give me new strength for every new day.
So Jojo wash plate, and Pip dry every cup. Baby Bee give kiss, and Biscuit lick the crumbs. That night Pip whisper, as she hold her tight, I love you, Mommy. Just human. Just right.
Because He know how He take make us; He remember say we be dust. Psalm 103:14

So God create man for Him own image, for God image na so He create am; man and woman na so He create dem. Genesis 1:27. Make una carry each other load, and na so una go fulfil the law of Christ. Galatians 6:2.

Covenant verses. But people wey dey wait for the Lord go get new strength; dem go fly high like eagle; dem go run, dem no go tire; dem go waka, dem no go faint. Isaiah 40:31. I go praise You, because You make me for wonderful and fearful way. Psalm 139:14. You make am small small lower pass angels, and You crown am with glory and honour. Psalm 8:5.
Mommy want ice cream. She don dey crave am whole day: just one scoop for herself, when the pikin dem no dey near.
I don behave well, she tell herself. I deserve small treat. So she buy one cone wey look too sweet.
One scoop… then maybe two, with cherry for top. Nobody see her, so she no want stop.
She take one cold, happy bite and her worry fly go: e taste like sunny, sweet, perfect holiday.
But soon e reach time to go carry the pikin dem. She drive with her ice cream, she relax well well…
…until she reach her pikin dem, wey turn with big surprise, the dripping cone dey shine for their big hungry eyes.
MUMMY! Na ICE CREAM be that?! Jojo shout from him seat. You TALK say you dey diet! Where MY own? Pip cry.
And quick quick that happy small moment come feel too small. She wish say she think about dem, or share with dem all.
So Mommy turn and talk, Una correct. I sorry. I for talk am, or keep small bite for una.
But one small truth dey, she talk, wey I want make una know. She draw everybody near and relax her shoulder.
Mommy fit tire. Mommy fit feel down. Mommy dey want small treat sometimes. I think say una suppose know.
I be person, like una. I dey learn every day. I no go always get am right; I go slip for road.
So abeg, when Mommy fall hand, una go fit get small more patience with my human side?
Because Mommy dey laugh, dey cry, dey try and dey learn, and Mommy dey make mistake sometimes… because she na human too.
Make una dey kind to each other, get soft heart, forgive each other… Ephesians 4:32
Love dey patient, love dey kind. 1 Corinthians 13:4. But we carry this treasure for clay pot, so that the great power go be God own, no be our own. 2 Corinthians 4:7.

Covenant verses. Make una carry each other load, and na so una go fulfil the law of Christ. Galatians 6:2. Make una confess una fault give each other, and pray for each other, so that una go heal. James 5:16. Give, and dem go give you. Luke 6:38.
E start like morning wey dey run too fast: bread burn, one shoe lost, and time dey fly pass.
Then Baby Bee pour cereal. And Biscuit bark. School bag no ready, and car key no dey find.
Pip lose one sock. Jojo homework na today. And every second dey make morning harder.
Inside, small pressure start to rise like steam, like kettle wey dey hot, ready to shout.
She beg dem, Abeg get ready! one time, two, three, four. But nobody hear her, and the wahala dey increase.
And then everything pour comot; she no mean am, but Mommy BIG LOUD VOICE comot, and every mouth close.
Kitchen quiet well well. Every small face stand still. And Baby Bee small lip start to shake…
…Mommy see their big eyes and her heart come small. That no be the voice wey she wan use at all.
She kneel down for kitchen floor, draw breath, gather her pikin dem near, and talk soft again:
I shout, and e no good. The big loud voice na my own. Una no force me, and una no do anything wrong.
I allow too many feelings gather, bubble too fast, so dem burst comot the loudest way. I sorry for the shout.
I dey learn, like una, how to hold rough day: to breathe before I boil, and find softer way.
So when my voice big again, and yes, one day e go happen, I go catch am, I go say sorry, and I go hold una closer.
Because Mommy dey try, dey fall and dey learn whole day, and Mommy voice dey big sometimes… because she na human too.
Make every man quick to hear, slow to talk, slow to vex. James 1:19
Soft answer dey turn vex away, but hard word dey raise anger. Proverbs 15:1. Vex, but no sin; no let sun go down on top your vex. Ephesians 4:26.

Covenant verses. Make una remove all bitterness, vex, anger, shouting and bad mouth from una, with every wickedness. Ephesians 4:31. Person wey slow to vex better pass strong man; and person wey control him spirit better pass person wey capture city. Proverbs 16:32. Lord, put guard for my mouth; watch the door of my lips. Psalm 141:3.
The house full of stamping feet, song and play, and since morning everybody dey shout MUMMY!
Jojo want Mommy. Pip want am too, and more. And Baby Bee dey beat pot and pan for kitchen floor.
TV dey blast, and Biscuit dey bark for every sound. No even one small corner of quiet.
Mommy feel say her ear don full, like cup wey dey fill one drop, another drop, till e start to pour.
So Mommy talk, I love una all. I need small time: just five quiet minutes, then I go come back with smile.
But Jojo face fall. You dey vex? And Pip frown. And Baby Bee, wey no sure, push her lip down.
Dem follow her for every corridor. Dem find her everywhere. Dem peep under bathroom door to see her quiet place.
So Mommy kneel down draw dem close. Make I clear am: me wanting quiet no mean say I no want una near.
I no dey vex. I love una even with noise. I love una every day. But sometimes Mommy ear go full; e need break from play.
Mama be like your tablet when battery low: she need one quiet minute for charger, then she go shine.
No be say I love una less. Na so I love una MORE: Mommy wey rest dey play and laugh better pass before.
And quiet good for una too; come rest with me: small hush, small calm, e sweet well well.
So Jojo breathe. Pip lie down. Baby Bee yawn. And Biscuit curl, nose to tail, till noise finish.
Because Mommy dey hug, dey help and dey give whole day, and Mommy need quiet rest… because she na human too.
Una come for quiet place… and rest small. Mark 6:31
Una calm down, and know say I be God. Psalm 46:10.

Covenant verses. Una wey dey labour and carry heavy load, come meet me, and I go give una rest. Matthew 11:28. When una return and rest, una go dey saved; for quiet and trust, na there una strength dey. Isaiah 30:15. He dey make me lie down for green grass; He dey lead me for side of quiet water. Psalm 23:2.
E be ordinary day, toys dey floor, when Jojo turn corner see something new.
Mommy sit for staircase, her shoulder down, and something wet dey shine for her cheek.
Pip come dey whisper, She dey leak! Baby Bee just dey look. And Biscuit press him cold nose for her body, like say e care.
You wound? Jojo ask soft. We do something bad? Na my fault? Pip whisper. Na why you dey sad?
Mommy carry dem for her lap, hold dem, one, two, three. No o, she talk. No one of una do me this tin.
Sometimes big person heart dey full with tins wey too heavy: worry, missing somebody, or day wey cold too much.
And when e full, e need to pour, like cloud must rain. Tears na how heavy heart dey release small pain.
So to cry no be to spoil. To cry no be weak or wrong. Na how heart dey drop something wey e carry too long.
You dey cry when e pain you. You dey cry when you fear. And Mommy get heart like your own: na so God make us.
So Jojo bring tissue. Pip climb up hold her tight. And Baby Bee pat her, soft like breeze.
And Biscuit put him heavy head on top her knee, like say, You hold us. Now we dey hold you.
Mommy laugh with tears, clean her cheek and breathe: Una no need to fix am. Una just need sit near me.
Sad tin no dey stay forever. Feelings dey come and go. But love dey stay through everything. I want make una know.
Because Mommy dey laugh, dey hurt and dey feel whole day, and Mommy eye dey rain sometimes… because she na human too.
Crying fit stay for night, but joy dey come for morning. Psalm 30:5.

Covenant verses. Rejoice with people wey dey rejoice, and cry with people wey dey cry. Romans 12:15. The Lord dey near people wey their heart don break. Psalm 34:18. Blessed be people wey dey mourn, because dem go get comfort. Matthew 5:4.
Monday, Jojo talk am once. Tuesday, e talk am twice: Thursday na Show-and-Tell, Mummy! And Mommy talk, Nice!
She write am for small paper, stick am for door. But small paper dey fall sometimes and hide.
Then Thursday come scatter scatter: something pour, rush rush, one shoe lost, dog dey bark, and comb no dey find.
Dem reach school. Bell don ring. Jojo turn back. Him hand empty. And him eye go down slow slow.
Na Show-and-Tell, him talk so soft Mommy almost no hear. And something drop for her belle. She no find word.
She don forget. True true. And nothing much to talk. No busy morning fit give am back him day.
She kneel down for door side, look am for eye. I forget. E important to you. And I no go lie.
I fit tell you say I busy, say things hard. But you tell me two times on purpose. And I for remember.
To forget no mean say you no matter. That one no true. E mean say my head full, and I let am push you out.
So see wetin I go do, she talk. I go set alarm, and put your Thursday for my phone, where e no fit fall.
And when we reach house, you go show me first. You go tell me everything. Because tin wey matter to you, e matter to my heart.
Jojo think am. Then him shrug small. Okay, Mummy. Him squeeze her hand. Then him hug am.
Because sorry no be just word wey you talk and waka. Na wetin you do for Friday. Na the promise you keep.
So Mommy dey try, dey fall, and dey start fresh every day, and Mommy still dey forget sometimes… because she na human too.
Even if righteous man fall seven times, e go stand up again. Proverbs 24:16
My small pikin dem, make we no love with mouth or tongue only, but with action and truth. 1 John 3:18.

Covenant verses. If we confess our sins, He dey faithful and just to forgive us and wash us clean from all wrong. 1 John 1:9. Bear with each other and forgive each other… as Christ forgive una, na so una too must do. Colossians 3:13. Make your yes be yes, and your no be no. James 5:12.
The list long and every line na for small pikin: new shoe for Pip, book for Jojo, socks and snacks.
Baby Bee don grow one size. Biscuit plate empty. But Mommy name no dey anywhere for the list.
Her shoe get hole. Her coat thin. Her comb don lose tooth. She don manage without tins so long, she forget.
For market, Jojo ask, Mummy, wetin YOU dey buy? And Mommy talk, Ah, nothing. I no need anything.
But Pip look her old shoe, then look her own. Mummy, your own get hole, Pip talk, bigger pass me!
Then Jojo talk something wey make her stop for the aisle: Mummy, you dey buy everything for us. You dey buy something for yourself sometimes?
And Mommy stand there, carry everybody tins, dey wonder when she learn to act like say she no need anything.
She kneel down. Una correct, she talk. I get something to confess: I dey give, give, give to una, and I no keep anything for myself.
I think say to love una mean say I must always do without. But una dey always watch me. And na why e matter.
If I talk say Mommy no count, one day una go talk say UNA no count, say una no go ask, say una need no matter.
But una count. And I count. And family na place where everybody need get seat, get space.
So that day Mommy put shoe wey fit her inside the cart. Jojo hail. Pip clap hard. And Baby Bee shout, YAY!
Biscuit wag tail. And for road, the list finally correct: something for each person, and one for Mommy too.
Because Mommy dey give and give whole day, and Mommy need things sometimes too… because she na human too.
Love your neighbour like yourself. Mark 12:31

I go praise You, because You make me for wonderful and fearful way. Psalm 139:14. My dear, I pray say make you prosper for everything and get good health, as your soul dey prosper. 3 John 1:2. Una no know say una body na temple of the Holy Spirit wey dey inside una? 1 Corinthians 6:19.

Covenant verses. And my God go supply everything wey una need, according to Him riches for glory through Christ Jesus. Philippians 4:19. Look the birds for sky: dem no dey plant, dem no dey harvest, dem no dey keep for store; yet your Father for heaven dey feed dem. Una no worth pass dem? Matthew 6:26. Her pikin dem dey stand up call her blessed. Proverbs 31:28.
Some mornings dey wake heavy, and sky forget im blue, and Mommy heart quiet, even though she get work to do.
She drive for the same old street, pass water sprinkler for lawn, and catch, with one eye, small rainbow. Then… e disappear.
The woman still dey water. Motor still dey pass. But Mommy hold that rainbow like letter from sky.
Small glimpse, she tell the pikin dem, of one old, true promise: the bow wey God hang for cloud wey dey talk, 'I remember you.'
The world dey drop small gifts wey many people dey rush pass: flower for crack for road, shadow for grass.
E fit no mean anything to another person. But if e make your heart look up, that glimpse na for you.
So Jojo find feather. Pip, flower for crack. And Baby Bee find Biscuit tail, wey dey always wag back.
But wetin about night? Jojo ask. When light no stay? Ah, Mommy talk, dey smile. Night get another tin to talk.
Dem watch sky together till dark swallow the blue, and on top the roof… the faithful moon come out.
Every single night, she talk, the moon dey come back again. E no dey skip the hard nights. E dey show even then.
So when you see am dey shine, make e whisper wetin true: God no go anywhere. He still dey with you. He care, He care for you.
Some days go feel too heavy. Some nights go feel too long. But small glimpses dey keep heart awake till dark go.
Now every day dem dey gather dem: rainbow, bird, or flower, and every night dem dey wave hello when God hang the moon.
Because Mommy heart dey turn grey, and she need glimpses too: Mommy dey look for rainbow… because she na human too.
I put my bow for cloud, e go be sign of covenant… Genesis 9:13

E go stand forever like the moon, like faithful witness for sky. Psalm 89:37. Na the Lord mercy make we no finish, because Him compassion no dey fail. E dey new every morning: Your faithfulness big well well. Lamentations 3:22-23.

Covenant verses. Every good gift and every perfect gift dey come from above, from the Father of lights. James 1:17. When I look Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars wey You put there. Psalm 8:3. I no go ever leave you, I no go ever forsake you. Hebrews 13:5.
Uncle come visit, and Jojo jaw tight. Everything Uncle do be like say e wrong; nothing feel right.
Toys must line by size. Breakfast na 7 o'clock sharp. Chair pillow must match exactly. Him rules strong well well.
How Uncle go love all of us, if rules first and play last? If everything must strict like this, how love go hold?
Mommy hold Jojo hand and sit down. Make I tell you true story about your Uncle and him heart, and wetin make am the man wey e be.
Your Uncle serve him country. E wear uniform with pride. But when wahala come, when times hard and soldiers cry,
him mind learn say order mean survival. Arrangement keep am alive. So now your Uncle dey arrange everything: na so e sabi feel okay.
One verse dey, Mommy talk, wey I want make you know: Love dey patient, love dey kind. Na so true love dey grow.
Love no dey talk, 'You must be like me, or I go turn away.' Love dey talk, 'I see who you be. I know you. And I still choose you.'
Later, Pip come meet Jojo, she vex and feel small: Jojo, Uncle shout me because I move the toys!
Then Jojo, with sense wey pass him seven years, hold him sister hand: Pip, Bible talk say make we know people wey dey labour among us. Make I explain.
Uncle no vex with YOU, Pip. E vex with the scatter scatter. Him mind dey talk say order dey keep am safe. Na so e dey find peace.
Time dey to play, and time dey to respect wetin other people need. When Uncle ask us to arrange tins, na so we dey plant love.
To love people no always easy. But e mean say you go learn their way. You no need be like Uncle, but today you dey honour am.
So Jojo love him Uncle by meeting am where e stand, and teach him sister say love wey no get condition dey talk: I see you. I understand.
Know the people wey dey labour among una… 1 Thessalonians 5:12
Love dey patient, love dey kind; love no dey jealous; love no dey boast, e no dey puff up. 1 Corinthians 13:4. Everything get im season, and time dey for every purpose under heaven. Ecclesiastes 3:1.

Covenant verses. So, as God chosen people, holy and dearly loved, una wear mercy, kindness, humble mind, gentleness and patience. Colossians 3:12. I don love you with love wey no get end; na why I draw you with kindness. Jeremiah 31:3. Love each other like brothers; dey honour each other pass yourself. Romans 12:10.
Grandma come watch the small ones as Mommy go out, and Mommy kneel near Jojo: I get work for you today.
Plate need rinse, toys go inside box, and Biscuit bowl need water; then you free to do the rest.
I don show you one hundred times. I know say you sabi. I trust you, Jojo. Na why I fit leave the work with you today.
But Pip find blocks, Bee find paint, and Biscuit find shoe, and Jojo think, I go do am. Time plenty.
Him play game. Him build fort. Clock dey go. Plate dey sit. Toys dey outside. Water bowl dry.
Then Biscuit push him empty bowl and cry small, and Jojo belle turn: Ah! Na my work be that!
Him remember Mommy face that morning, kneel down dey talk I trust, and something inside am stand up tall: I fit. I go do am. I must.
Him fill the bowl reach top. Him rinse every cup and spoon. Him gather every block and car, dey hum work song.
Pip come help small, and Bee clap her hands, and Jojo show dem how dem dey do am, like big boy.
When Mommy key turn for door, she stop look round: plate dry, toys arranged, no single scatter.
You do am, Jojo, well well! she talk with shining eye. And Jojo talk the truth: I play first. She smile: That na wisdom.
To talk truth na part of trust, and to finish work too. Well done, my good and faithful son; I go trust you with more.
Then Mommy sit for chair and drop her shoulder: I tire too. Some days I need helper pass anything.
Because Mommy trust you, and she need you to do your part, and Mommy need helper sometimes… because she na human too.
Well done, good and faithful servant: you don faithful for small tin, I go put you over plenty tin… Matthew 25:21
Person wey faithful for small tin go faithful for plenty too. Luke 16:10. Anything wey una do, do am with all your heart, as for the Lord, no be for man. Colossians 3:23.

Covenant verses. Even small pikin, dem dey know am by wetin e dey do, whether him work clean and correct. Proverbs 20:11. Trust the Lord with all your heart, no lean on your own understanding. Proverbs 3:5. Give your way to the Lord; trust Am, and He go do am. Psalm 37:5.
I Think Say Your Head Don Go
The day dey go scatter scatter and the list dey long, and everything Mommy touch be like say e dey spoil.
She put milk for cupboard and cereal for fridge, and dey find key wey dey her hand, one, two, three times!
She dey talk to nobody; she stir tea with biro; she call the dog Jojo, then call Jojo Biscuit!
Then Pip stand for doorway, hand for waist: Mummy, I think say your head don go! e jump comot her mouth.
Kitchen quiet. Jojo freeze. Bee drop spoon. And Biscuit tiptoe comot the room.
Mommy almost reply sharp, No talk to me like that! But she stop, look Pip, and think wetin to talk.
Because her girl see her clear, confused, rushing, spinning, and feel safe to tell her so. And that one na brave tin.
So Mommy laugh big laugh and raise the two keys: You correct! My head don travel. Somebody find am, abeg!
Then Mommy kneel draw Pip close. I happy say you fit see, and say you fit tell me true. Na wetin I want, you and me.
But honest word fit still dey kind; e dey land soft. Next time try: 'Mummy, you dey okay? You no dey act like yourself.'
So Pip talk, Mummy, you dey okay? And Mommy talk, No too much. I tire, Pip. I dey do plenty. I need help tonight.
So Jojo put the milk back, and Pip find Mommy shoe, and Baby Bee bring her hug, the best one she fit choose.
Because house where truth dey safe, where hard word dey come out kind, na there pikin fit always talk wetin dey her mind.
Because Mommy dey rush, and dey confuse well well, and Mommy head dey go sometimes… because she na human too.
But as we dey talk truth with love, make we grow for everything inside Am… Ephesians 4:15
Make una talk always get grace, with salt inside, so una go know how to answer everybody. Colossians 4:6. Lying lips na wetin the Lord hate, but people wey dey do truth na Him joy. Proverbs 12:22.

Covenant verses. My grace dey enough for you: because my power dey complete for weakness. 2 Corinthians 12:9. Because He know how He take make us; He remember say we be dust. Psalm 103:14. Word wey you talk for correct time, e sweet well well! Proverbs 15:23.
Mommy always cook breakfast, always pack the bags, always find missing shoe and wash dirty cloth.
But one grey morning Mommy stay under blanket: her nose red, her head hot, her voice no correct.
Mommy sick, she talk with rough voice. Sorry. I no fit stand up today. And Pip talk, Sick? But Mummy, na you dey make everything okay!
Then Jojo look Pip, and Pip look Jojo: if Mommy no fit take care of dem… wetin dem go do?
So Jojo bring cereal, and Pip bring spoon, and Baby Bee carry all her balloon give Mommy.
Dem dey whisper for corridor make Mommy head rest, and Biscuit lie down near the bed, guard her well.
Pip bring cup of water. Jojo bring book. And Baby Bee climb up give her one long, worried look.
Mummy, e dey pain you? Jojo ask. Just small, she talk. I go better soon. My body need one day for bed.
But you be Mummy, Pip talk. Mummy no dey sick! And Mommy laugh one rough laugh.
Ah, mamas dey catch cold, Pip. We dey get fever too. We need soup, rest and care, the same as una.
When you sick, I hold your hand and sing for you for night. Today una dey take care of me, and una dey do am well.
So Jojo read story slow, and Pip sing song, and Baby Bee sleep deep for afternoon.
Two days after, Mommy wake dey sing, she strong, and hug dem tight: Una take care of me well well whole day!
Because Mommy dey take care of you whole year, and Mommy need care sometimes… because she na human too.
I sick, and una visit me… Matthew 25:36
Two better pass one; because dem get better reward for their work. Ecclesiastes 4:9. Friend dey love every time, and brother dey born for time of trouble. Proverbs 17:17.

Covenant verses. The Lord go hold am up for sick bed; You go make im bed well for him sickness. Psalm 41:3. And prayer of faith go save the sick, and the Lord go raise am up. James 5:15. Make una carry each other load, and na so una go fulfil the law of Christ. Galatians 6:2.
Dem enter motor go visit Auntie new house, with snacks and songs, and Baby Bee with biscuit for her face.
Mommy drive, drive, drive, pass bridge, shop and tree. I know the road, she tell everybody. We go reach easy.
But the roads come look different, and the signs strange and new, and Mommy hand tight for steering: she no get clue.
We don reach? Jojo ask. We don reach? Pip ask too. And Mommy talk, Not yet, then Not yet, and Not yet again.
Dem pass the same red filling station once, twice, and one more time. Mummy, Jojo talk, I think say we don pass that shop before!
So Mommy park for side and draw long breath: I don lose road, she talk. I think say I know. True true. Ah.
Motor quiet well well. Pip eye big and wide. But mamas dey always know road, she whisper.
No be always, Pip, Mommy talk. Big people dey take wrong turn too. And when e happen, the brave tin na to ask for help. Na wetin we dey do.
So Mommy call Auntie, and listen word by word: Turn left for the big white church, then right.
Jojo watch for the big white church, Pip watch for the sign, and Baby Bee watch Biscuit tail, and everything fine.
Thank you, team, Mommy talk. I no for fit do am alone. To ask no be failure. Na so big people dey find road go house.
Dem reach Auntie house late, with horn and with shout, and Auntie laugh, Una don reach! Come inside, finally!
And Jojo talk, When I lose road, I go ask for help, like you. And Mommy smile. Me too. I still dey learn.
Because Mommy dey drive, dey plan and dey lead whole day, and Mommy dey take wrong turn sometimes… because she na human too.
For all your ways, acknowledge Am, and He go direct your path. Proverbs 3:6
I go teach you and show you the road wey you go follow; I go guide you with my eye. Psalm 32:8. Where no counsel dey, people go fall; but where plenty counsellors dey, safety dey. Proverbs 11:14.

Covenant verses. Your ear go hear word behind you wey go talk: Na this road, waka for am. Isaiah 30:21. Your word na lamp for my leg, and light for my road. Psalm 119:105. If anybody among una no get wisdom, make e ask God, wey dey give everybody free without complain, and He go give am. James 1:5.
When the whole house don sleep and plate don wash finish, Mommy open her books: second day don start.
Jojo come down for water, see kitchen light: Mommy dey table, dey write till late night.
Mummy, wetin you dey do? I dey study, she talk. I dey go back to school, Jojo. Now you suppose dey bed!
School? But Mummy, you be big person! You never finish school? No o, she laugh. Dream fit grow for any age. Na the rule.
When I small, I dey dream to build, to fix, to make tins, to learn how hot air dey flow, and wetin cold air dey bring.
But then I get you, Jojo, then Pip, then our Bee, and I keep all my dreams so I fit take care of una three.
But I no stop to dream. I keep am for shelf. And now I dey bring am down, to grow one part of myself.
But Mummy, you look tired, Jojo talk, dey rub him eye. I tire, she talk. Some nights long. But dreams worth the try.
Next day Mommy yawn for breakfast, pour small juice, and Pip talk, Mummy dey sleep! and everybody laugh.
Then Jojo get idea: We fit help you too, Mummy! We go do our homework near you, as you dey study!
So every night for seven o'clock, for table, side by side, everybody book come out, and Mommy full of pride.
Pip dey study with her crayon. Baby Bee dey chew page. And Jojo dey read him chapter book, the best for him age.
And the day Mommy pass her exam, dem make sign: OUR MOMMY DO AM! with glitter, star, and Pip best squiggle line.
Because Mommy get her dreams, and she dey grow too, and Mommy dey tire well well sometimes… because she na human too.
Write the vision, make am clear for tablet, so that person wey dey read am fit run. Habakkuk 2:2
Give your work to the Lord, and your plans go stand. Proverbs 16:3. I dey press go the mark for the prize of God high calling for Christ Jesus. Philippians 3:14.

Covenant verses. Because I know the plans wey I get for una, na so the Lord talk, plans of peace, no be of evil, to give una future and hope. Jeremiah 29:11. Wisdom na the main tin; so get wisdom: and with everything wey you get, get understanding. Proverbs 4:7. But people wey dey wait for the Lord go get new strength; dem go fly high like eagle; dem go run, dem no go tire; dem go waka, dem no go faint. Isaiah 40:31.
Bills dey table, and the motor don make noise, and Mommy forehead squeeze as she dey waka round kitchen.
Jojo see her dey rub her eye. Pip see her dey bite her lip. And Baby Bee see Mommy coffee dey cold, no single sip.
Mummy, you dey worry? Jojo ask, soft and low. And Mommy breathe. Small. I be human too, you know.
Then Mommy enter her room close the door gently, and Jojo peep through the crack, see her for floor:
no be say she wound, no be say she sad, but she kneel, hand raise for prayer, dey whisper to God above, wey dey always listen.
Lord, I no get all the answers, I no fit fix everything. But You fit. So I dey give You every worry wey I bring.
Then Mommy clean her eye and stand, her shoulder light. She open door and smile. Now Mommy dey alright.
Wetin you dey do? Pip ask. I dey pray, Mommy talk. When big people get big worry, we dey carry am go meet God.
Big people must pray? Jojo ask. Una no know everything? No o, Mommy talk, dey laugh. Near God, I small well well.
I dey pray when I worry, and I dey pray when I happy. I dey pray when things sweet, and when things dey spoil.
We fit pray with you? Pip ask. So all of dem kneel down: Jojo, Pip and Baby Bee, with Biscuit curl round.
Pip pray make the motor start again. Jojo pray for Mommy day. And Baby Bee shout Amen! loud: na her favourite word.
The worries no disappear one time, but something new dey for house: one peace wey dey talk, God dey take care of you.
Because Mommy dey worry, and she dey give her worries to God too, and Mommy need to pray sometimes… because she na human too.
No worry for anything; but for everything, with prayer and begging and thanksgiving, make una tell God wetin una need. Philippians 4:6
Throw all your worry give Am; because He care for you. 1 Peter 5:7. And the peace of God, wey pass all understanding, go guard una heart and una mind through Christ Jesus. Philippians 4:7.

Covenant verses. Because where two or three gather for my name, I dey there for their middle. Matthew 18:20. Pray without stopping. 1 Thessalonians 5:17. Throw your load give the Lord, and He go hold you up: He no go ever let righteous person shake. Psalm 55:22.
Leo Louis Lion and the Smoky Sky
Leo Louis Lion wake up see strange grey sky. No be rain sky. No be night sky. Na smoky sky. Mama, e talk, the sky look like say e sick.
Mama Lion look up for long, long time. You know wetin, my small one? she talk. I no know everything about that sky. But I know how to find out. And I know say we fit do am together.

So dem go see. The smoke no come from their house. E come from far, far away, from forest wey dry so tey e catch fire. But e no even hot here, Leo talk. Na the tin be that, Mama talk. The smoke travel come all this way to visit us.
Leo breathe. E scratch. Small small ash dey for the air, Mama talk. Na why e hard to breathe. So today we go play near house, Leo.
But why, Mama? Why the forest dry like that? Mama sit near am. That one, she talk, na very big question. And big question deserve real answer.
The whole earth dey wear blanket, Mama talk. Blanket wey dem make with air. Small blanket dey keep us warm reach. That one good.
But when the world burn too much, too many fire, too many engine, day and night, the blanket go dey thick dey thick. And blanket wey thick too much go make the whole earth too hot.
When e hot too much for long, rain go dey far. Grass go turn brown. Trees go thirst and dry. And dry forest dey catch fire easy. Leo eye open wide. So the smoke… come from the blanket?
In a way, Mama talk. Then she quiet small. The truth be say, Leo, I no always know this one. I learn am small small. Big people still dey learn too.

So wetin we fit do? Leo ask. We be just lions. Mama smile. Two tins. We fit reduce fuel: burn less, waste less, waka more. And we fit plant trees, because trees dey drink the heavy air and help the blanket light again.
Leo look the grey sky again. Mama… e go don fix by tomorrow? Mama draw long, slow breath. She no want tell am anything wey no true.

See the truest tin wey I know, she talk. Long time ago, the sky get another wound. And all the animals for all the lands look up, see am, and talk, 'E don do. Make we fix am together.' And you know wetin happen? The sky start to heal.
So no, Leo, I no fit promise you tomorrow. But I fit tell you how good tins dey happen. No be by one lion. By many lions, wey decide together, and then do something.
Leo Louis Lion raise him chin, steady, like the name wey dem give am. Then I go tell the others, e talk. I go teach every cub wey I know. Mama heart full. Na exactly so, she talk.
And na so dem do. One seed. One lesson. One brave young lion, dey teach the next. The earth na gift. Dem give us am to keep.
And the Lord God take the man, put am for the garden of Eden to work am and keep am. Genesis 2:15

The earth na the Lord own, and everything wey dey inside; the world, and people wey dey live there. Psalm 24:1. Ask the animals now, dem go teach you; and the birds for sky, dem go tell you. Job 12:7.

Covenant verses. And God see everything wey He make, and e good well well. Genesis 1:31. As long as earth dey, planting time and harvest, cold and heat, dry season and rainy season, day and night no go stop. Genesis 8:22. Wicked man dey run when nobody dey chase am, but righteous people bold like lion. Proverbs 28:1.
